studies.label: Phase-contingent AI access in three-person teams (product-design task)
studies.cluster_se_treatment: The main planned contrasts and timing models analyze one team-level score per randomized team. Timing-model SEs are HC3 robust at the team observation level, with task fixed effects. This respects randomized team clustering without treating members or ratings as independent. Robustness-model uncertainty is separately marked unclear where its specification is not printed.

arms.name: C1 Divergent AI
arms.description: Integrated AI assistant available during divergent search only. PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4.

arms.name: C2 Convergent AI
arms.description: Integrated AI assistant available during convergent selection only; the PDF identifies this as the corrected convergent-stage label. PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4.

arms.name: C3 Full-process AI
arms.description: Integrated AI assistant available throughout divergent search, convergent selection and final consolidation. PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4.

arms.name: C4 No AI
arms.description: No LLM interface or AI assistance at any stage. PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4.

arms.name: C5 Divergent AI + warning
arms.description: Divergent-stage access as in C1 plus a persistent warning below the query input encouraging critical discussion of AI suggestions. PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4.

studies.task: Teams produced a written product or service concept combining a backpack with a pet accessory, a refrigerator with a calendar, or shoes with a map, with divergent search, convergent selection and final consolidation within one continuous task.

open_items: The original randomized participant and team allocation counts are not printed. The planned session count is not treated as the actual pre-exclusion sample; clusters_per_arm contains analyzed teams (Supplementary Table 1).
Supplementary Table 15 does not identify the parenthetical dispersion statistic. SD and SE fields for alpha diversity, proposal count and document length remain null.

Participant-level creativity SDs are not printed; the main composite SD is across team-level output scores. Dimension SDs are absent, and the precise standardizer for reported Hedges g is not specified.

Expert-only rater membership, mixed-model random effects/observation units, the headline bootstrap resampling scheme, and the meaning of the leave-one-rater-out Hedges-g-range summary are not sufficiently specified for pooling those sensitivity records.
The PDF calls human-rated creativity primary but does not establish preregistered primary-outcome status; the preregistration itself is not reproduced.

The study country and DeepSeek V3.2 release year are not explicitly printed. Student population follows student-ID login and grade/discipline covariates; author affiliations are not used as the study location.

Supplementary Figure 5 caption differs slightly from Supplementary Table 5 for some headline effects/p values. Main numeric fields follow the dedicated contrast tables and the more precise calibrated means in Table 12.
Exact numerical intervals/SEs for standardized mechanism coefficients and figure-only AI-family leave-one-out effects are unavailable outside the plotted figures and are not digitized.
notes: Extraction B read the entire markdown conversion, including all Supplementary Information, and extracted cited PDF pages with pymupdf. PDF tables, figures and supplementary results were inventoried before design/method extraction. No new data-derived statistic is computed. Inventory: Tables 1 and 12 give composite arm levels/SDs and calibration sensitivity; Tables 5-7 give planned raw differences, intervals, Hedges g and p values; Tables 8-10, 16 and 22 give timing-model coefficients, HC3 SEs, intervals and p values; Table 13 gives headline sensitivity estimates, with Table 29 supplying a more precise mixed-model p value; Table 15 gives final-output alpha diversity, rated proposal count and character-count means with unidentified dispersion; Figure 8 caption additionally prints standardized alpha-diversity and proposal-count coefficients. Repeated copies of the same estimates in Tables 6-7 and model/figure crosswalks are not duplicated. Raw calibration means and alternative estimators are separate sensitivity records. Timing Stage1, Stage2 and Warning coefficients map to C1-C4, C2-C4 and C5-C1 under the explicitly printed saturated design coding; full-process interaction increments are listed in not_extracted instead of being misassigned to two arms. All retained outputs belong to the same continuous creative task with phase-restricted assistance. AI is available during part of their production even when disabled at final submission, so these are with_ai rather than a new unassisted after_ai task. There is no across-team output-similarity outcome: alpha diversity concerns idea units within a team. The study is a laboratory experiment despite its online workspace. The analytic sample and team formation do not establish the original number randomized. No shared-sample declaration was found; shared_sample is null. The supplied citation record provides version identity, while the document itself remains undated. Printed numerical precision and scientific notation are preserved in source quotes even where JSON numeric serialization drops trailing zeros. No plot coordinates or figure-only labels are used for numbers. No web search or external API request was needed, and no file other than the requested extraction JSON was written.
